problem.unknownClient.message: {service} doesn't list {client} for this account. Test the connection to refresh its clients.
problem.unknownClient.note: client: the service's own client id, OL2019; service: Litmus or Mailgun Inspect

problem.notConnected: No rendering service is connected to this workspace.
problem.stillRunning: A render of this campaign is still running. Its screenshots appear as they arrive.

problem.refused.message: {service} refused the API key. Check it in your {service} account and paste it again.

problem.unreachable.message: {service} couldn't be reached ({reason}). Try again in a minute.
problem.unreachable.note: reason: a short technical reason, Timed out

problem.failed.message: {service} answered with an error (HTTP {status}). Try again in a minute.

render.gaveUp: {service} didn't finish within 15 minutes. Render again to retry.
render.disconnected: {service} was disconnected before the screenshots arrived.
render.noScreenshots: {service} couldn't capture any of the clients.
